films.desc_en: A slow, cinematic journey through the timeless Macedonian tradition of roasting red peppers in the autumn.
films.music: soulful acoustic guitar, warm cello, gentle percussion, 75 bpm

shots.kf: Wide shot of a misty autumn sunrise over a vast harvested field in the Pelagonia region. A rustic wooden cart sits prominently in the foreground. Soft golden hour light is piercing through the dense fog. Shot on a 35mm lens, cinematic composition, muted earthy color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dense fog rolls slowly across the harvested field, accompanied by a very slow, cinematic push-in camera movement.

shots.kf: Close-up of large, vibrant red Kapia peppers resting in a woven wicker basket on a wooden table. Rich, deep red tones contrasting with weathered wood. Soft, diffused natural light pouring from a nearby window. 50mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A very slow, subtle camera pan from left to right across the textured surface of the vibrant peppers.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a traditional black iron wood stove outdoors, with bright orange flames glowing intensely inside the open door. The setting is a rustic outdoor stone courtyard. Warm, flickering firelight beautifully contrasts with the cool ambient autumn twilight. 85mm lens, moody contrast, rich textures, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Flames flicker and dance wildly inside the iron stove, paired with a slow camera push-in.

shots.kf: Close up of red peppers roasting on the flat metal top of the iron stove. The skin is beautifully blistered and charred black in spots. Wisps of white smoke rise elegantly. Warm golden lighting emphasizes the deep red colors. 85mm macro lens, high detail, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick wisps of smoke rise organically from the roasting peppers while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a rustic clay bowl filled with freshly mashed, rich red ajvar spread, sitting on a heavy oak table. A wooden spoon rests inside. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, dark background, deep crimson and amber color palette. 50mm lens, highly textured, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Subtle steam rises gently from the warm red spread, captured with a slow circular camera orbit.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a cozy outdoor wooden table set with a glass jar of ajvar, rustic bread, and a traditional ceramic jug, set against a backdrop of a glowing Macedonian sunset over distant mountains. Warm ambient light, inviting atmosphere. 35mm lens, cinematic framing, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A gentle evening breeze subtly rustles the background leaves, accompanied by a slow pull-back camera move.

films.line_en: Your perfect start to the day.
films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical ad capturing the morning crave for traditional flaky pastry and fresh yogurt.
films.music: upbeat modern electronic beat, driving rhythm, 120 bpm

shots.kf: Extreme close-up, vertical framing. A golden, flaky traditional round baked pastry fresh from the oven, resting on a rustic wooden board. Intense, dramatic studio lighting highlighting the incredibly crispy texture and layers. 90mm macro lens, warm golden tones, visually striking, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Visible heat waves and steam burst upwards, while the camera tilts down quickly focusing on the crust.

shots.kf: Medium shot, vertical framing. A continuous thick stream of creamy white fresh yogurt falling into a clear glass. High contrast studio lighting, bright clean whites standing out against a dark slate background. 50mm lens, perfectly centered composition, clean aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick yogurt pours continuously into the glass in a smooth flow, with a slow camera push-in.

shots.kf: Medium shot, vertical framing. A perfect slice of the golden layered pastry sits on a dark ceramic plate next to a full glass of thick yogurt. Morning sunlight streams through an unseen window, casting dynamic diagonal shadows. 35mm lens, vibrant, appetizing, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes float gently in the sunbeam, accompanied by a slow dynamic camera orbit around the plate.
